youtube_description:
First video, as a demo reel, in which I share some of my skills as a Creative AI Prompt Engineer using generative artificial intelligence tools. 

In this video, I introduce April, a character completely created using AI, whose voice has also been generated by the same technology. I have developed the ability to create consistent photorealistic characters in Midjourney, and I have used this knowledge to develop an efficient dataset, which is very important.

I have used this dataset to train a model in Dreambooth to use in Stable Diffusion 1.5. After testing, I have been able to verify that it is 100% operational. 

I would also like to highlight the use of ControlNet in some of the photographs and the fact that all jungle images have been processed with Stable Diffusion 1.5. 

I hope you enjoy watching my work and share it. Thank you for your support!
youtube_title: AI Prompt Engineer (Demo Reel 2023) - April in the jungle
